source: enum names and numbers are the Enum Metadata the measurement plug-in's generated Register gRPC Messages VIs record; the Python classes are NI's protobuf packages (ni/ni-apis-python) and protobuf's own type_pb2
flat_typedef_suffix_source: the gRPC scripting tools' Create Enum Data Clusters (simple).vi names a second typedef of the same enum values with the name plus Get Constant.vi's FlatTypeDefSuffix (OneOf Constants), the string _Flat; the Flat typedef holds the identical items, and only the plain name is registered (Register Enum Metadata), so a Flat name is the enum of the plain name
